# Copilot Instructions

- Purpose: guide AI agents working across the AI Orchestrator (FastAPI + task queue + memory) and the Orchestrator Web Viewer (FastAPI + static frontend).
- Repos: primary code in ai-orchestrator; a mirrored web viewer lives at /scripts/modules/orchestrator_web_viewer for pip -e installs—edit ai-orchestrator/orchestrator_web_viewer unless told otherwise. Key docs: [README.md](README.md), [docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md](docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md), [docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md](docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md), [memory/README.md](memory/README.md), [orchestrator_web_viewer/README.md](orchestrator_web_viewer/README.md).
- Architecture: PostgreSQL + pgvector container; orchestrator container (FastAPI) bind-mounts task_queue, logs, config; host-only: kmtui, CLI workers (claude/codex/gemini), llama.cpp/RTX 5090. Orchestrator reaches host via host.docker.internal and polls the shared task_queue volume.
- Task queue (see [docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md](docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md)): queued/ → assigned/ → in_progress/ → completed/|failed/ plus results/<id>/. Task files are UUID-named JSON; mutate state via atomic rename/move only. Do not rename or reshape directories; kmtui/workers depend on them.
- Memory (see [memory/README.md](memory/README.md)): schema in memory/models.py, vector search in memory/vector_store.py, API in memory/manager.py, embeddings via embed_repo.py on GPU. PostgreSQL is source of truth; vector backend is replaceable.
- Containers (see [docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md](docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md)): orchestrator expects TASK_QUEUE_PATH=/app/task_queue, LLAMA_CPP_HOST=host.docker.internal, LLAMA_CPP_PORT=8080, POSTGRES_* envs. Keep host CLIs out of containers unless strategy is updated.
- Core workflows: build/start all with ./build_all.sh or ./start.sh; stop via ./stop.sh; rebuild orchestrator with docker compose build orchestrator && docker compose up -d orchestrator; logs via docker compose logs -f orchestrator; health at http://localhost:8000/health.
- kmtui: installed from scripts repo; talks directly to PostgreSQL; writes queued tasks into host task_queue. Preserve KM_* envs noted in [README.md](README.md).
- Web UI (koweb): code in orchestrator_web_viewer/. Run via koweb CLI (pip install -e modules/orchestrator_web_viewer/[termdash]) using KO_WEB_* envs; default port 3001. APIs in orchestrator_web_viewer/api/*.py, WebSocket manager in orchestrator_web_viewer/websocket/manager.py, static assets in orchestrator_web_viewer/static/.
- Visual capture workflow: use [skills/web-ui-visual-debug/SKILL.md](skills/web-ui-visual-debug/SKILL.md) to spin up koweb/frontends, open the live page, and capture screenshots for visual QA. Persona helper: [.github/agents/web-ui-visual.agent.md](.github/agents/web-ui-visual.agent.md).
- Testing discipline: follow [.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md](.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md) to run pytest quietly before and after changes, add coverage-focused tests for new code, and fix failing tests vs code appropriately.
- Tests: web viewer tests via pytest orchestrator_web_viewer/tests/ (or modules/orchestrator_web_viewer/tests/ from scripts repo). Orchestrator lacks broad automated coverage—validate with docker compose flows.
- Logging/results: orchestrator logs bind-mounted to logs/; task artifacts live under task_queue/results/<task-id>/. Keep paths stable.
- Safety: never delete/rename task_queue subfolders; do not commit docker/.env or secrets; document host-only assumptions (GPU, CLIs) instead of baking them into images.
- API/queue changes: mirror REST style in docker/orchestrator/main.py and conform payloads to docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md JSON shapes.
